title: Network Approach to Understanding Emotion Dynamics in Relation to Childhood Trauma and Genetic Liability to Psychopathology: Replication of a Prospective Experience Sampling Analysis
n_timepoints: 6 consecutive days, 10 90-min intervals per day, random beeps
limitations: - Limited set of emotional states to avoid convergence issues; - Floor effects due to low reporting of negative emotions in general population; - Sample may not be representative of overall population due to age and living situation; - Differences in means under high CT exposure may affect network comparability; - Methodology lacks balanced error control (Type I/II); - No preregistration.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are publicly available. Preregistration status is not mentioned in the paper. The study is a replication of a previous analysis, but no preregistration link or declaration is provided.
